title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern
company_overview: We build customer-facing web applications and creator tools that empower businesses to launch online stores and manage multi-channel sales seamlessly.
responsibilities: Build and ship features from database models to frontend UI components.
Work across the stack with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
Participate in product requirement reviews, agile sprints, and pair programming sessions.
Ensure high performance, accessibility, and reliability across user workflows.
required_skills: Proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript and modern web standards.
Experience building user interfaces in React and backend services with Node.js/Express or Python.
Basic knowledge of SQL databases and CRUD operations.
Git version control and collaborative workflows.
preferred_skills: Experience with Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, and TailwindCSS.
Familiarity with cloud hosting platforms (Vercel, AWS) and Docker.
cultural_competencies: High agency, resourcefulness, and self-starter mentality.
Collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for peer code reviews.
